proof_body:
by
  intro a M c p h hp ht
  have hb : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨M, fun n => (le_abs_self _).trans (h n)⟩
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  obtain ⟨s, h1, h2⟩ := exists_between hc
  have h3 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, a n < s := Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt h1 hb
  have h4 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, a (p n) < s := hp.tendsto_atTop.eventually h3
  have h5 : c ≤ s := le_of_tendsto ht (h4.mono fun n hn => hn.le)
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (M c : ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℕ), (∀ n, |a n| ≤ M) → StrictMono p → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a (p n)) Filter.atTop (nhds c) → c ≤ Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop
